_: Verified catalog of the Skills & MCP page: well-known open-source projects, checked by hand (repository, licence, install line from the project's own README). Skills are downloaded from GitHub when installed; MCP servers run in a cage (system/mcp-jail.sh) or are remote.

description.en: Runs a Godot project, reads its debug output, creates scenes and nodes. Needs Godot installed in Linux.
description.fr: Lance un projet Godot, lit sa sortie de débogage, crée des scènes et des nœuds. Godot doit être installé dans Linux.
description.es: Ejecuta un proyecto Godot, lee su salida de depuración, crea escenas y nodos. Requiere Godot instalado en Linux.

description.it: Avvia un progetto Godot, legge l'output di debug, crea scene e nodi. Serve Godot installato in Linux.
description.pt: Executa um projeto Godot, lê a saída de depuração, cria cenas e nós. Requer o Godot instalado no Linux.

mcp.sauvegarde: the editor keeps changed levels and assets in memory: save all of them (the server's save tool, or the editor command it can run) so that the .umap and .uasset files of the project change, then commit them.

description.en: Drives the open Unreal editor (actors, lights, materials, tests) through the MCP plugin of the Unreal project; the pilot opens the editor before each cycle. Run commands\unreal-network.cmd once. Experimental.
description.fr: Pilote l'éditeur Unreal ouvert (acteurs, lumières, matériaux, tests) via le plugin MCP du projet Unreal ; le pilote ouvre l'éditeur avant chaque cycle. Lancez une fois commands\unreal-network.cmd. Expérimental.
description.es: Controla el editor Unreal abierto (actores, luces, materiales, pruebas) mediante el plugin MCP del proyecto Unreal; el piloto abre el editor antes de cada ciclo. Ejecute una vez commands\unreal-network.cmd. Experimental.
description.de: Steuert den geöffneten Unreal-Editor (Akteure, Lichter, Materialien, Tests) über das MCP-Plugin des Unreal-Projekts; der Pilot öffnet den Editor vor jedem Zyklus. Führen Sie einmal commands\unreal-network.cmd aus. Experimentell.
description.it: Pilota l'editor Unreal aperto (attori, luci, materiali, test) tramite il plugin MCP del progetto Unreal; il pilota apre l'editor prima di ogni ciclo. Esegui una volta commands\unreal-network.cmd. Sperimentale.
description.pt: Controla o editor Unreal aberto (atores, luzes, materiais, testes) através do plugin MCP do projeto Unreal; o piloto abre o editor antes de cada ciclo. Execute uma vez commands\unreal-network.cmd. Experimental.

mcp.sauvegarde: Studio keeps the place in memory: save it into the project as one `.rbxlx` file, always the same one (with the server's tools if one saves or exports the place), and keep every script you write as a `.luau` file in the project too. If you cannot save the place yourself, write it in `.athanor/LOG.md` and in your final answer: the user saves it in Studio (File > Save to File).

description.en: Drives the open Roblox Studio (scripts, instances, play tests, assets) through Studio's built-in MCP server, which runs on Windows. Open Studio with your place before the cycle; in Studio, Assistant > … > Manage MCP Servers, turn on “Enable Studio as MCP server”. Experimental.
description.fr: Pilote Roblox Studio ouvert (scripts, instances, tests en jeu, ressources) via le serveur MCP intégré à Studio, qui tourne sous Windows. Ouvrez Studio avec votre expérience avant le cycle ; dans Studio, Assistant > … > Manage MCP Servers, activez « Enable Studio as MCP server ». Expérimental.
description.es: Controla Roblox Studio abierto (scripts, instancias, pruebas de juego, recursos) mediante el servidor MCP integrado en Studio, que se ejecuta en Windows. Abra Studio con su experiencia antes del ciclo; en Studio, Assistant > … > Manage MCP Servers, active «Enable Studio as MCP server». Experimental.
description.de: Steuert das geöffnete Roblox Studio (Skripte, Instanzen, Spieltests, Assets) über den in Studio integrierten MCP-Server, der unter Windows läuft. Öffnen Sie Studio mit Ihrem Erlebnis vor dem Zyklus; in Studio unter Assistant > … > Manage MCP Servers „Enable Studio as MCP server“ einschalten. Experimentell.
description.it: Pilota Roblox Studio aperto (script, istanze, test di gioco, risorse) tramite il server MCP integrato in Studio, che gira su Windows. Apri Studio con la tua esperienza prima del ciclo; in Studio, Assistant > … > Manage MCP Servers, attiva «Enable Studio as MCP server». Sperimentale.
description.pt: Controla o Roblox Studio aberto (scripts, instâncias, testes de jogo, recursos) através do servidor MCP integrado no Studio, que corre no Windows. Abra o Studio com a sua experiência antes do ciclo; no Studio, Assistant > … > Manage MCP Servers, ative «Enable Studio as MCP server». Experimental.
